changeSet.author: koala
changeSet.sql: WITH ranked_primary AS ( SELECT id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at, id) AS position FROM bank_accounts WHERE is_primary = true AND is_active = true AND is_deleted = false ) UPDATE bank_accounts account SET is_primary = false FROM ranked_primary ranked WHERE account.id = ranked.id AND ranked.position > 1;
